about:
Wildcat Electronics, Inc. is based in Fountain Inn, South Carolina. The company identifies as woman-owned, a designation highlighted on its website and in its certifications. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The firm manufactures a range of electronic interconnection components, including printed circuit pins, sockets, adapter boards, capacitors, and multiple DIP socket variants (closed frame, glass epoxy, open frame). It also supplies pin headers, SIP connectors, surface mount caps, and terminals. Beyond standard products, Wildcat offers custom engineering services, such as bifurcated designs for larger diameter components, and can cross-reference competitors' part numbers.

The company does not specify the industries it serves in its public materials. Its customer base likely includes electronics manufacturers and OEMs requiring interconnect solutions, but no concrete industry verticals or named clients are provided.

Wildcat emphasizes a customer-first philosophy with the tagline 'We Report to a Higher Authority.....Our Customers!' It promotes its engineering expertise for custom parts and presents custom orders as routine, suggesting flexibility and responsiveness as key differentiators.
